newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Bombay LAN to Glencore at -$27.45/T.
newsitem.headline: India sells Bombay LAN to Glencore at -$27.45/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) sold by tender August low aromatic naphtha (LAN) from Bombay to Swiss trader Glencore at $27.436 per tonne below Japanese spot naphtha quotes, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender offered the 25,000-tonne cargo for August 9-11 lifting on a free-on-board (fob) basis from the west coast. It closed on July 31 and was valid for one day.
IOC's last LAN cargo from Bombay for July 20-22 lifting was also sold to Glencore at $33.75 per tonne discount to spot U.S. Gulf 87-octane gasoline quotes, fob.
